summary: Contestants demonstrate their skills in spreadsheet applications by formatting data, creating formulas, and sharing information for analysis. All work is completed on-site and submitted electronically. The event is open to any middle level contestant.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
submission_requirements: All student-produced jobs completed on-site are uploaded electronically and are not printed at the national level
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
competencies: Demonstrate basic skills in the creation and editing of spreadsheets
Create formulas, including calculations that include order of operations and absolute cell reference
Create graphs and charts using spreadsheet data
Display spreadsheets to show formulas and gridlines
Export files as pdf to submit
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this application event.
